capabilities: Retry transient EBUSY failures when writing notes, Canvas files, and other vault files
Show or hide notices containing EBUSY or resource busy or locked
Set sync-lock notice opacity from 0% to 100%
Switch between the original technical error text and a compact Chinese status message
Preview both notice styles from the plugin settings
disambiguation: It does not sync files itself; it only retries locked saves and manages the error notices shown while Baidu Netdisk syncs.
extras: Manual installation only (copy main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). Requires Obsidian Desktop 1.13.7+ on Windows; desktop only. README warns that hiding notices or setting opacity to 0% can make real save failures invisible and recommends keeping backups. No telemetry, analytics, or network requests. Not affiliated with Baidu or Obsidian and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: When a third-party sync client like Baidu Netdisk locks vault files, Obsidian shows transient EBUSY save-failure notices with no retry and no way to filter or restyle them.

relations.evidence: Designed for Windows vaults stored in Baidu Netdisk Sync Space.

summary: Desktop plugin that retries transient EBUSY save failures in vaults stored in Baidu Netdisk Sync Space and controls how sync-lock notices appear.
